raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Related to #38024 and #23074.

On multi-node NVLink fabric (MNNVL, e.g. GB200/GB300 NVL72) systems running disaggregated prefill/decode with `--disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl`:
1. `maybe_init_custom_mem_pool` (`python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/utils.py`) previously required `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL` to be set and imported `mooncake.allocator.NVLinkAllocator` (`mooncake-transfer-engine`), while `KvVmmArena` (`kv_vmm_backing.py`) is gated off for MLA models (`overrides.py: if mla_enabled: return False`).
2. In NIXL deployments where `mooncake-transfer-engine` is not installed (or `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL` is unset), every KV cache pool — including both multi-layer target `MLATokenToKVPool`/`MHATokenToKVPool` instances and speculative EAGLE's separate 1-layer draft `MLATokenToKVPool` — falls back to PyTorch's default `cudaMalloc` pool (`CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_NONE`), preventing `CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC` export across nodes and forcing UCX/NIXL onto host TCP.

## Modifications

- **`python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/fabric_mem_pool.py`**:
  - Add `CudaVmmFabricAllocatorStub`, a native, size-unbounded `torch.cuda.memory.CUDAPluggableAllocator` compiled with `with_cuda=False` (resolving `cuDeviceGet`, `cuMemCreate`, `cuMemRelease`, `cuMemAddressReserve`, `cuMemAddressFree`, `cuMemMap`, `cuMemUnmap`, `cuMemSetAccess`, and `cuMemGetAllocationGranularity` from `libcuda.so.1` via `dlopen`/`dlsym`, so neither `nvcc` nor CUDA toolkit headers are required at runtime).
  - Allocate physical pages with `CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC` (probing `gpuDirectRDMACapable=1` first per device and automatically falling back to `gpuDirectRDMACapable=0` when GPUDirect RDMA is unavailable) with no minimum size cutoff, so both target KV pools and smaller speculative EAGLE draft KV pools, `MambaPool`, and staging buffers are fabric-exportable.
  - Cache one `torch.cuda.MemPool` per CUDA device inside `with torch.cuda.device(cuda_dev):` (`get_cuda_vmm_fabric_mem_pool`) so multiple KV pools on the same GPU safely share one `MemPool` without rebuilding the C++ stub or hitting cross-thread device-0 `use_count` assertions.
- **`python/sglang/srt/environ.py`**: Add `SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL = EnvBool(True)` to control automatic activation for NIXL on MNNVL fabric-ready GPUs.
- **`python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/mooncake/utils.py`**:
  - Add `"FABRIC"` to `SUPPORTED_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL_TYPES` (and reject `"FABRIC"` alongside `"NVLINK"`/`"BAREX"` under `MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL=efa`).
  - Fall back to the native CUDA VMM `"FABRIC"` pool on fabric-ready GPUs (`is_gpu_fabric_ready(device)`) when `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL=NVLINK` (or `"True"`) raises `ImportError` on `mooncake.allocator`.
- **`python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/utils.py`, `python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/common/staging_handler.py`, `python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/overrides.py`, & `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/engine.py`**:
  - Auto-enable the native `"FABRIC"` custom memory pool in `maybe_init_custom_mem_pool` (and `staging_handler._get_custom_mem_pool`) when `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL` is unset, `SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL` is `True`, `disaggregation_mode in ("prefill", "decode")`, `disaggregation_transfer_backend == "nixl"`, `not enable_memory_saver`, and `is_gpu_fabric_ready(device)` is `True`.
  - Skip `post_capture_kv_sizing_planned` and single-node `kv_shard_symmetric_scratch` when `nixl_fabric_custom_mem_pool_planned(cfg)` is `True` (matching existing `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL` behavior).
- **`test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_fabric_mem_pool.py` & `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_efa_allocator.py`**: Add unit tests covering JIT compilation & C++ `malloc`/`free` tracking across large target and small draft allocation sizes, per-device `MemPool` singleton reuse, `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL=FABRIC` and `NVLINK` `ImportError` fallback, NIXL auto-activation and `SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL=0` opt-out, EFA validation, and `post_capture_kv_sizing_planned`.

## Accuracy Tests

Allocator-only backing change (`CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC` VMM backing for `torch.cuda.MemPool`); tensor layouts, dtypes, and kernel math are unchanged. Unit tests verified via:
- `python test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_fabric_mem_pool.py -v` (7/7 passed)
- `python test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_efa_allocator.py -v` (2/2 passed)
- `python test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py -k "post_capture_kv_sizing" -v` (1/1 passed)

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Enables zero-dependency `CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC` KV cache export across MNNVL cliques for both target KV pools and speculative EAGLE draft KV pools under `--disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl`, avoiding silent fallback to host TCP when `mooncake-transfer-engine` is absent.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

Related to #38024 and #23074: on MNNVL systems running disaggregated PD with `--disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl` without `mooncake-transfer-engine`, target and speculative EAGLE draft `MLATokenToKVPool` pools fell back to `cudaMalloc` (`CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_NONE`), preventing `CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC` export. Tests: `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_fabric_mem_pool.py` and `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_efa_allocator.py`.

+        )
+        gran = 2 * 1024 * 1024  # 2 MiB VMM recommended granularity
+        stub.set_mock_mode(True, granularity=gran)
+        self.addCleanup(stub.set_mock_mode, False, gran)
+
+        # Both multi-GiB target KV buffers and smaller speculative EAGLE draft
+        # KV buffers must be backed without any minimum size cutoff.
+        target_req_bytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 + 4096
+        draft_req_bytes = 64 * 1024 * 1024 + 512
+
+        ptr_target = stub._fn_malloc(target_req_bytes, 0, None)
+        ptr_draft = stub._fn_malloc(draft_req_bytes, 0, None)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(ptr_target)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(ptr_draft)
+        self.assertNotEqual(ptr_target, ptr_draft)
+        self.assertEqual(ptr_target % gran, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(ptr_draft % gran, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(stub.active_allocations, 2)
+
+        expected_target = ((target_req_bytes + gran - 1) // gran) * gran
+        expected_draft = ((draft_req_bytes + gran - 1) // gran) * gran
+        self.assertEqual(stub.mapped_bytes, expected_target + expected_draft)
+        self.assertEqual(stub.last_error, 0)
+
+        stub._fn_free(ptr_draft, draft_req_bytes, 0, None)
+        self.assertEqual(stub.active_allocations, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(stub.mapped_bytes, expected_target)
+
+        stub._fn_free(ptr_target, target_req_bytes, 0, None)
+        self.assertEqual(stub.active_allocations, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(stub.mapped_bytes, 0)
+
+    def test_per_device_singleton_mem_pool_reused_across_target_and_draft_pools(self):
+        entered_devices = []
+
+        @contextmanager
+        def fake_cuda_device(dev):
+            entered_devices.append(dev)
+            yield
+
+        fake_stub = SimpleNamespace(allocator=object())
+        created_pools = []
+
+        def fake_mem_pool_ctor(allocator):
+            pool = SimpleNamespace(allocator=allocator, idx=len(created_pools))
+            created_pools.append(pool)
+            return pool
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                fabric_mem_pool, "_get_allocator_stub", return_value=fake_stub
+            ),
+            patch("torch.cuda.device", side_effect=fake_cuda_device),
+            patch("torch.cuda.MemPool", side_effect=fake_mem_pool_ctor),
+        ):
+            target_pool_d2 = fabric_mem_pool.get_cuda_vmm_fabric_mem_pool("cuda:2")
+            draft_pool_d2 = fabric_mem_pool.get_cuda_vmm_fabric_mem_pool(
+                torch.device("cuda", 2)
+            )
+            target_pool_d0 = fabric_mem_pool.get_cuda_vmm_fabric_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+
+        self.assertIs(target_pool_d2, draft_pool_d2)
+        self.assertIsNot(target_pool_d2, target_pool_d0)
+        self.assertEqual(len(created_pools), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            entered_devices,
+            [torch.device("cuda", 2), torch.device("cuda", 0)],
+        )
+
+    def test_explicit_fabric_and_nvlink_importerror_fallback(self):
+        sentinel_pool = object()
+
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL.override("FABRIC"),
+            patch.object(
+                fabric_mem_pool,
+                "get_cuda_vmm_fabric_mem_pool",
+                return_value=sentinel_pool,
+            ),
+        ):
+            enabled, pool, pool_type = maybe_init_custom_mem_pool("cuda:1")
+            self.assertTrue(enabled)
+            self.assertIs(pool, sentinel_pool)
+            self.assertEqual(pool_type, "FABRIC")
+
+        # When SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL=NVLINK (or True) is set in a
+        # NIXL-only image without mooncake.allocator, fabric-ready GPUs fall
+        # back to the native CUDA VMM FABRIC pool instead of cudaMalloc.
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL.override("True"),
+            patch.dict("sys.modules", {"mooncake": None, "mooncake.allocator": None}),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.utils.cuda_vmm_utils.is_gpu_fabric_ready",
+                return_value=True,
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                fabric_mem_pool,
+                "get_cuda_vmm_fabric_mem_pool",
+                return_value=sentinel_pool,
+            ),
+        ):
+            enabled, pool, pool_type = init_mooncake_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+            self.assertTrue(enabled)
+            self.assertIs(pool, sentinel_pool)
+            self.assertEqual(pool_type, "FABRIC")
+
+        # Non-fabric GPUs keep the existing default-pool fallback on ImportError.
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL.override("NVLINK"),
+            patch.dict("sys.modules", {"mooncake": None, "mooncake.allocator": None}),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.utils.cuda_vmm_utils.is_gpu_fabric_ready",
+                return_value=False,
+            ),
+        ):
+            enabled, pool, pool_type = init_mooncake_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+            self.assertFalse(enabled)
+            self.assertIsNone(pool)
+            self.assertIsNone(pool_type)
+
+    def test_auto_nixl_fabric_activation_and_opt_out(self):
+        sentinel_pool = object()
+        override = get_context().override_server_args(
+            disaggregation_mode="decode",
+            disaggregation_transfer_backend="nixl",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+        )
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL.override(None),
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL.override(True),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(fabric_mem_pool, "is_gpu_fabric_ready", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(
+                fabric_mem_pool,
+                "get_cuda_vmm_fabric_mem_pool",
+                return_value=sentinel_pool,
+            ),
+        ):
+            # Target pool, speculative draft pool, and staging buffer all
+            # receive the same FABRIC MemPool automatically.
+            enabled_t, pool_t, type_t = maybe_init_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+            enabled_d, pool_d, type_d = maybe_init_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+            staging_pool, staging_type = staging_handler._get_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+            self.assertTrue(enabled_t)
+            self.assertTrue(enabled_d)
+            self.assertIs(pool_t, sentinel_pool)
+            self.assertIs(pool_d, sentinel_pool)
+            self.assertIs(staging_pool, sentinel_pool)
+            self.assertEqual(type_t, "FABRIC")
+            self.assertEqual(type_d, "FABRIC")
+            self.assertEqual(staging_type, "FABRIC")
+
+            # Opt-out env var disables automatic activation cleanly.
+            with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL.override(False):
+                enabled_off, pool_off, type_off = maybe_init_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+                self.assertFalse(enabled_off)
+                self.assertIsNone(pool_off)
+                self.assertIsNone(type_off)
+
+        # Non-fabric hosts (e.g. RoCE/InfiniBand without MNNVL clique) stay off.
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL.override(None),
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL.override(True),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(fabric_mem_pool, "is_gpu_fabric_ready", return_value=False),
+        ):
+            enabled_ib, pool_ib, type_ib = maybe_init_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0")
+            self.assertFalse(enabled_ib)
+            self.assertIsNone(pool_ib)
+            self.assertIsNone(type_ib)
+
+    def test_unpublished_runtime_context_and_memory_saver_return_false(self):
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL.override(None),

+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL.override(True),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(fabric_mem_pool, "is_gpu_fabric_ready", return_value=True),
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(maybe_init_custom_mem_pool("cuda:0"), (False, None, None))
+
+    def test_nixl_fabric_custom_mem_pool_planned_predicate(self):
+        cfg = MagicMock(
+            device="cuda",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+            disaggregation_mode="prefill",
+            disaggregation_transfer_backend="nixl",
+        )
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL.override(True),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch("torch.cuda.current_device", return_value=0),

+        ):
+            self.assertTrue(fabric_mem_pool.nixl_fabric_custom_mem_pool_planned(cfg))

+
+    def test_post_capture_kv_sizing_skips_when_nixl_fabric_pool_planned(self):
+        from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import post_capture_kv_sizing_planned
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import Backend, CudaGraphConfig
+        from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+
+        prefill_graph = SimpleNamespace(backend=Backend.BREAKABLE, bs=[4096])
+        args = ServerArgs(
+            model_path="dummy",
+            enable_kv_cache_sharding=False,
+            device="cuda",
+            dcp_size=1,
+            kv_cache_dtype="auto",
+            prefill_only_disable_kv_cache=False,

+        with (
+            patch(

+            envs.SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL.override(None),
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL.override(True),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch("torch.cuda.current_device", return_value=0),
+            patch.object(fabric_mem_pool, "is_gpu_fabric_ready", return_value=True),

issue_comments.body:
Could a maintainer add `run-ci` and review? Every test job was skipped; the red checks are `pr-gate` and the `*-finish` jobs that wait on it.

Related to #38024 and #23074: on MNNVL systems running disaggregated PD with `--disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl` without `mooncake-transfer-engine`, target and speculative EAGLE draft `MLATokenToKVPool` pools fell back to `cudaMalloc` (`CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_NONE`), preventing `CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC` export. This PR adds a zero-dependency `CudaVmmFabricAllocatorStub` (`libcuda.so.1` VMM `CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC`, per-device `MemPool` singleton across target and draft pools), `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL=FABRIC` + `NVLINK` `ImportError` fallback, and auto-activation for `--disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl` on fabric-ready GPUs (`SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_FABRIC_MEM_POOL=1`, default on).

Tests: `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_fabric_mem_pool.py` and `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_efa_allocator.py`.
